entities.name: Red Wizards of Thay
entities.description: Two Red Wizards on a secret mission into the High Moors, searching for something or someone.

entities.name: High Moors
entities.description: Cold, windswept hills east of the Sword Coast in Faerun where the Red Wizards search and a barrow mound stands.

entities.name: Barrow mound
entities.description: A mound in the wild grasses of the High Moors holding the remnants of a wizards' sanctum that is still being plundered.

entities.name: Sword Coast
entities.description: The coast west of the High Moors in Faerun.

events.summary: Two Red Wizards of Thay undertake a secret mission into the High Moors, escorted by mercenaries who think they should be stopped.
events.quote: Two Red Wizards of Thay have undertaken a secret mission into the High Moors east of the Sword Coast.

events.summary: Pursuing the wizards leads the adventurers to a barrow mound where a wizards' sanctum is being plundered.
events.quote: At the barrow, they discover the remnants of a wizards' sanctum still being plundered.

relations.note: The barrow stands in the wild grasses of the High Moors.
relations.quote: a barrow mound in the wild grasses of the High Moors
